title: Reusable questions for reading diplomatic evidence

cases.title: Consent has more than one stage
cases.question: Did acceptance of the peace plan mean a treaty had been signed?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Which stage is actually evidenced: acceptance of a principle, agreed wording, signature, ratification, implementation, or only an expectation?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: Different countries, dates and reported stages are being compared; this does not establish a single uniform treaty process.

cases.title: A mediation signal is not a mandate
cases.question: How strong was the September mediation signal?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Who authorized the position, how many reporting layers intervene, what conditions apply, and is an armistice separately evidenced?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: These are different actors’ statements, not one formally agreed negotiation record.
No response is not silently recoded as rejection or acceptance.

cases.title: Reciprocity and reservations alter the proposition
cases.question: Did the powers accept the same naval rules?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Was the precise proposal accepted, and did reciprocity, reservations or modifications change its scope?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: This comparison preserves attributed legal positions; it does not adjudicate their validity or prove compliance.

cases.title: A restriction can change within a limited route
cases.question: What changed in code traffic to Puerto Rico?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Are two observations about the same carrier, route, scope and date, or are you generalizing a local change?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: The first statement is a company complaint and the second a government report of company information; neither is a measured transport audit.

cases.title: A zero and an exemption need boundaries
cases.question: Can one daily report show censorship stopped?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: What are the observation window, channel, covered population, exceptions and evidentiary limits of a zero or exemption?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: An administrative promise to explain cases is not evidence that every disputed cable was resolved.

cases.title: Assistance depends on authority and capacity
cases.question: What did taking charge of foreign interests actually authorize?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Does the evidence distinguish custody, protection, authority, non-exclusivity and actual local capacity?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: The Whitlock publisher record includes a later reply; whole-record historical filtering conservatively withholds affected date views.
No guarantee of safety or military alliance follows from these statements.

cases.title: Request, assent and authorization are different steps
cases.question: When did the Belgian food plan move from request to U.S. authorization?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Which party requested action, which party assented, which authority authorized it, and what evidence shows actual execution?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: Dates refer to these records; recipient receipt, delivery and operational success are separate questions.

cases.title: An assurance has a sender, channel and duration
cases.question: Was all relief food guaranteed against seizure?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Who gave which assurance, to whom, through which channel, for how long, and was it prospective or already operative?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: Promised future assurances and reported written assurances are distinct. Neither establishes actual compliance.

cases.title: Replies resist a yes-or-no summary
cases.question: Had the hospital-supply exemption been agreed?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Can you separate a proposal, assent in principle, a definition request, silence, an existing rule with exceptions and willingness to study?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid for reuse; not an empirical universal rule or legal instruction.
limitations: The record does not establish a completed uniform agreement, nor does it establish implementation.

cases.title: A dated report can arrive much later
cases.question: What could Washington infer from Vopicka’s July30 report before it arrived?
cases.reusable_checklist_question: Are composition, transmission, receipt and other possible information channels being treated separately?
cases.checklist_status: Assistant-authored analytical aid; not proof of historical mental states.
limitations: The printed receipt is September12. Other channels may have conveyed information earlier; this source does not establish their absence.
